description.text: The frame begins in near-total darkness, a field of deep charcoal black with no readable horizon, wall or floor. Only the faintest variation in the gloom suggests depth, as though a wide, unlit space extends far past every edge of the image. Then, low in the frame,

appears as a thin silhouette, its outline barely separable from the surrounding blackness — a long, low body crouched close to the ground. No highlights define its surfaces yet; the shape reads only as a denser absence of light, a soft-edged mass that the eye must hunt for. As the darkness holds, a very faint ambient sheen grazes the leading edge of the front bodywork, picking out one sliver of metal that glints dully and then subsides, leaving the rest of the vehicle swallowed again. The silhouette shifts almost imperceptibly, a suggestion of weight settling forward on its suspension. Everything else in the space stays unlit, uncluttered and still, so that the smallest gleam on that front edge carries the whole image.
